committed durable event; duplicates allowed, version-aware client application required

authorized participants, session IDs, expiry times; no hidden-document membership leakage
participant delta with expiry; connection loss eventually removes presence
authorized draft revision/content reference and edit-log cursor; no implicit write grant
committed document edit/revision and originating operation ID; exact same revision as HTTP command result
reason, scoped snapshot/replay link; discard incompatible projection and reload
Problem-compatible code, reply_to, retryability; forbidden subjects do not expose existence

account_endpoints.authority: Authenticated recipient plus one-time bound proof and revision
Authenticated operation recipient; no pre-admission workspace disclosure

collaboration_acceptance.acceptance: Invite acceptance is recipient-bound, single-use and idempotent; expired/revoked invitations fail without leaking workspace data; leaving/removing the last owner requires transfer
Two members in one workspace on different Go instances see the same permitted committed event; another workspace/member lacking programme access sees neither content nor counts
Remove a member during subscription/replay: further delivery and edits stop, queued old frames are reauthorized, client clears projections, historical attribution survives
Disconnect after commit before acknowledgement, reconnect on another instance, replay once in the UI; expired cursor yields fresh snapshot, not a silent gap
Multiple browser/desktop sessions expose only authorized presence; per-session expiry removes stale cursors; private Copilot and blinded scientific work do not leak activity
Two humans and a Cowrite agent concurrently insert/delete/format; server and all clients converge under the pinned edit protocol without lost edits
Reconnect rebases pending edits using their original IDs; duplicate sends commit once; compacted base preserves local draft and requests merge; revoked access rejects offline writes
Per-author undo preserves another person's intervening edits; accepting a stale suggestion detects conflict; submission seals an exact revision while successor draft remains editable
Duplicate/missed WebSocket wakes and socket loss do not duplicate claims or authorize work; polling catches missed work; lease heartbeat/cancellation remains authoritative
Slow client queues remain bounded; durable events force resync rather than silent loss; presence may coalesce; outbox wake loss or server restart recovers through durable catch-up
Human→lead→specialist→runtime chain retains initiating/authorizing/executing identities and canonical handoff refs; rejected terminal delivery remains recoverable/quarantined

Cleanup cannot delete artifacts pinned by release, negative result, active review or undelivered receipt; full disk stops new work; approved restricted-data erasure records unavailability and consequences
